title: Vista
description: Vista is a jar mod for Minecraft 1.2.5. It has no concrete theme, and its goal is to create a fun and unique experience. Some additions include: new stone types, beta villages, farlands, more world types, more piston functionality, more biomes, QoL, etc.
body:
Vista is a jar mod for Minecraft 1.2.5. It has no concrete theme, and its goal is to create a fun and unique experience. Vista adds both new content and quality of life features.

Recommended method of installation is by using "add to minecraft.jar" in Prism/MultiMC. Java 8 is the minimal version required, but Java 17 or above is recommended.

We have a Discord server where you can view planned features, see update teasers and development showcases, suggest features, report bugs, share your creations in the mod and discuss it with other players. The invite to the server is accessible through a button in the bottom left corner of the main menu.

Minecraft Vista's changes and additions can be viewed in the Discord server and in the version changelogs.
